subject: [PATCH] btrfs: zstd: avoid a copy in zstd_decompress_bio()

reviews.author: David Sterba
reviews.summary: reviewer noted that btrfs_decompress_buf2page() is retained for LZO and ZLIB, suggesting a similar optimization could be done for these algorithms as well
reviews.raw_body:
Nice, also good that it's measurable as it's a microoptimization. The
btrfs_decompress_buf2page() is there because of LZO which does not have
the internal copies. ZLIB uses it as well but I'm not sure if it's
needed and similar optimizaiotn could be done there as well. It's less
used because of zstd so we can keep it like that.

Reviewed-by: David Sterba <dsterba@suse.com>

2026-09-07.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the btrfs decompression process by avoiding an unnecessary copy of data from a scratch buffer to the destination folios. Instead, it uses zstd's streaming capabilities to write directly into the page cache. This approach reduces the number of stream calls when sectorsize exceeds PAGE_SIZE and eliminates the extra copy for output delivered to the read bio. The patch also includes benchmarking results showing improved performance in both sequential and random reads.
